description.value: Maya's is a seasonal ice cream and gelato shop on White Rock's scenic Marine Drive, right along a popular seaside cycling route. The shop was born from the owners' international travels and offers handcrafted gelato, creative soft serve sundaes, floats, paninis, and a full espresso bar. Online ordering is available for pint pickup and local delivery.

address.value: 15045 Marine Drive, White Rock, BC V4B 1C3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business as a seasonal ice cream and gelato shop at 15045 Marine Drive, White Rock, BC V4B 1C3, with phone 1-604-535-9132 matching OSM exactly. The OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'ORDER OUR PINTS AVAILABLE FOR PICKUP OR LOCAL DELIVERY' page. The cached website content shows a winter 2024 closure notice ('See you March 1st 2025!'), indicating a seasonal operation; no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website text.
concerns: Website content appears cached from the 2024 winter closure ('Closed for the winter season, See you March 1st 2025'). The business is seasonal — current 2026 season open status cannot be confirmed from cached content alone.
OSM cuisine tag includes 'italian' which may be a stretch; the business is primarily an ice cream and gelato shop with some Italian-inspired items (gelato, affogato).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible seasonal business on a major waterfront cycling route in White Rock; OSM flags looks_closed=false and the business has a clear seasonal pattern with confirmed reopening dates.
